frontier.hypothesis: A whole-function structure gives sum weighted-n_refs >= 11 (tie/beat j) WITHOUT a loop-note bracket at sum=0's def AND without deepening the tail, so sum wins $a0 (Region A) AND sum=0 emits first (Region A').
frontier.mechanism: reg_n_refs += loop_depth (flow.c): sum needs +1 depth-weighted ref over plain's 10. s9 reconfirmed from the rederive angle that this ref cannot come from a peeled accumulate (diverges, =12) nor a body reorder (undoes the RA win, =8) nor the tail (s8, cascades). It must come from a genuine depth>=2 sum reference GCC keeps in flow-counting but drops in codegen, in a block free of the outer IVs.
frontier.next_probe: Directed permuter on the floor-6 full-TU basin biased to accumulate-region restructures that add a non-coalescing depth-2 sum reference (the s2 acc-split coalesced; seek a variant GCC will NOT coalesce, e.g. a second live sum pseudo used post-loop). Vet against dead-store/constant-holder.

frontier.hypothesis: Drop j's loop-depth-weighted reg_n_refs from 11 to 10 so plain (low-LUID) sum=0 ties j and wins $a0 via the allocno tiebreak with NO do-while(0) (closes A and A' together).
frontier.mechanism: j total 11 = j=0(depth1) + j++(depth2) + j<0x24(depth2). Target keeps the exact bytes addu a1,zero,zero / addiu a1,a1,1 / sltiu v0,a1,0x24, so all three j references are byte-fixed; s9's asm read confirms j is a genuine up-counter (sltiu ...,0x24). No byte-neutral way to drop a j reference was found.
frontier.next_probe: Find a loop shape where the counter is initialized once at function scope yet still resets per outer iteration without a depth-1 store, OR a pointer-difference reformulation that removes one depth-2 j reference while keeping target's sltiu ...,0x24 byte (prior pointer-end attempts diverged from the integer counter).

frontier.hypothesis: Region B closes only if the two LICM range constants get LOWER LUID than the ap/a2p moves without a pre-loop reference (constant-holder cheat).
frontier.mechanism: loop.c move_movables emit_insn_before(loop_start) hard-codes the hoist point at preheader END (after ap/a2p moves); the constants are referenced only inside the k-loop so LICM controls placement. s9 m2c confirms the original had plain preloop moves + the constants referenced only inside the loop — no alternative source structure. Unchanged s1-s9.
frontier.next_probe: Design a k-loop where the range-test bound is genuinely loop-carried with a real dependency chain to the pointer moves (raising the moves' LUID above the constants), or where ap/a2p init is NOT a preheader insn (computed later/derived), so the hoisted constants become the first preheader insns. Vet against constant-holder/dead-alias.

judge_constraints: The index/pointer-reformulation sanction is contingent on semantic faithfulness — the index expressions must address exactly the memory the walking-pointer form does (verified here: byte-exact Region B, correct 0x78/0xD0 offsets). A reformulation that reads wrong memory (e.g. an s32*-typed alias yielding 0x340) remains broken/cheat. This ruling sanctions the floor-2 anchor's Region-B construct only; it does not certify completion — Region A' is still open and the match must reach score 0 before a FINAL CALL.
